request_context: A request to review a set of frontend code changes for design-system compliance, form handling patterns, type safety and test quality before they go to a teammate for approval.

rules.source_quote: Native HTML element used instead of Cloudscape component
rules.outcome: Flags raw HTML elements (generic containers, text spans, inputs, buttons, anchors) used where a design-system component exists as a blocking problem, and names the component that should replace each.
rules.why: Native elements bypass the design system's theming, accessibility and consistency, and they slip through if not called out.
rules.scenario_hint: Diff that renders layout or text with plain HTML containers and spans or native form controls.

rules.outcome: Flags inline style attributes in components as a blocking problem and recommends design-system spacing or layout components instead.
rules.why: Inline styles break design-system consistency and are hard to theme or maintain.
rules.scenario_hint: Diff where a component sets margins or colors through inline style objects.

rules.source_quote: Form state managed with `useState` instead of React Hook Form
rules.outcome: Flags form values and validation tracked in hand-rolled component state or custom hooks, rather than the project's form library, as a blocking problem.
rules.why: Ad hoc form state duplicates library features and creates inconsistent, bug-prone validation and re-render behavior.
rules.scenario_hint: Diff adding a form whose fields are held in separate local state variables.

rules.source_quote: Zod validation used — not manual validation
rules.outcome: Flags hand-written validation logic where a schema-based validation library should define the rules, and recommends moving the rules into a schema.
rules.why: Manual validation drifts from the schema and is inconsistent and untested.
rules.scenario_hint: Diff with if-statements checking field values and setting error messages by hand.

rules.outcome: Flags use of the untyped escape-hatch type in non-test code as a blocking problem and suggests a concrete type.
rules.why: It disables type checking and hides bugs that compile cleanly.
rules.scenario_hint: Diff where a handler or prop is typed as any in production code.

rules.outcome: Notes form setup calls that lack an explicit form-values type argument as a should-fix issue, rather than relying on inference.
rules.why: Without explicit types, field names and values are not checked and type errors go unnoticed.
rules.scenario_hint: Diff creating a form instance without a generic type parameter.

rules.source_quote: Dynamic column count in `ColumnLayout` (causes layout shift)
rules.outcome: Flags grid layouts whose column count changes with data or conditions as a should-fix issue because it shifts the layout, and recommends a fixed count.
rules.why: Variable columns cause visible layout jumps for users.
rules.scenario_hint: Diff where the number of columns is computed from the item count.

rules.source_quote: Test assertions check existence but not actual values
rules.outcome: Points out tests that only assert something is present or rendered without checking the actual content or values, and asks for assertions on real values.
rules.why: Existence-only assertions pass even when the output is wrong.
rules.scenario_hint: Diff adding component tests that only check an element is in the document.

rules.source_quote: Event handler not memoized (causes unnecessary re-renders)
rules.outcome: Flags event handlers recreated on every render and passed to children as a should-fix issue, recommending memoization.
rules.scenario_hint: Diff with inline arrow-function handlers passed to child components.

rules.outcome: Notes when error and edge-case paths, such as validation failures, have no test coverage and recommends adding tests for them.
rules.scenario_hint: Any request to review frontend changes that include tests.

rules.outcome: Points out unused imports, variables, dead code and needless wrapper components that should be removed.
rules.why: Dead code adds noise and maintenance burden.
rules.scenario_hint: Any request to review frontend changes.

rules.source_quote: Present findings as: CRITICAL → IMPORTANT → SUGGESTION.
rules.outcome: Findings are ordered from most to least severe, with blocking issues clearly separated from should-fix and optional ones.
rules.scenario_hint: Any request to review frontend changes.
